svg.aria-label: Frozen fine-tuned pi0.5 rolls out LIBERO tasks while its latents are read at every VLA call; every episode is cut to its first 8 calls and a separately trained detector predicts the eventual outcome. Episode AUROC: time-only 0.500 in both settings, VLA latent 0.823 on unseen rollouts and 0.790 on unseen tasks.
